title: Studio Page
purpose: Find a Studio, explore its design, and open its delivery.
audience: People working within a Block, Job or Task
product: A Studio browser with a dedicated detail page and large Draw viewer.
steps: Open the Draw and the product it proposes.
Read its delivery contract and open questions.
Open the source Studio in the workbench.
checks: Every row identifies its Studio and intended delivery.
Draw and delivery open from the same row.
The detail page keeps the reader oriented.
example: This Block presents its seven Studios, with direct delivery and Draw links.
open: Should a Studio detail open on its Draw or its delivery preview?
